title: Breaking Bad
overview: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future at any cost as he enters the dangerous world of drugs and crime.
worthSummary: Breaking Bad is widely regarded as one of the greatest TV series of all time, with exceptional writing, acting, and direction. The show's engaging storyline and well-developed characters have received universal acclaim. The reviews are overwhelmingly positive, with many considering it a must-watch. The series has been praised for its consistent quality and improvement throughout its progression.

title: Esaretin Bedeli
overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
worthSummary: The film receives overwhelmingly positive reviews for its timeless story, themes of hope and endurance, and emotional impact. Reviewers praise its ability to inspire and uplift, with many considering it a 'miraculous medicine' for those feeling down. The film's exploration of the inhumanity of prison is also noted, though one reviewer questions its adoption by certain demographics. Overall, the film is widely regarded as excellent and a must-watch.

title: Game of Thrones
overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.
worthSummary: Game of Thrones is a highly acclaimed series with outstanding early seasons, but its later seasons received criticism for rushed pacing and illogical moments. Despite this, many consider it a classic. The series has complex dialogue, intriguing storylines, and strong character developments. However, the final season's quality drop is a significant concern.

title: Baba
overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
worthSummary: The Godfather is a masterfully crafted gangster film, a character study, and a period piece, widely regarded as one of the greatest films ever made.
worthLowlights: Some viewers might find it too long
Not everyone will appreciate its complexity

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.
worthSummary: A Batman film with a notable scene featuring Cillian Murphy and Heath Ledger, but it also raises questions about oppressive systems and villainy. The film's commitment to its themes is evident, but some viewers may find it problematic. Overall, it's a thought-provoking but divisive film.
worthHighlights: Cillian Murphy's brief appearance is memorable
worthLowlights: Divisive themes may alienate some viewers

title: Chernobyl
overview: The true story of one of the worst man-made catastrophes in history: the catastrophic nuclear accident at Chernobyl. A tale of the brave men and women who sacrificed to save Europe from unimaginable disaster.
worthSummary: The series 'Chernobyl' is a highly acclaimed and authentic depiction of the 1986 nuclear disaster, praised for its attention to detail, historical accuracy, and emotional impact.
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the content disturbing

title: Band of Brothers
overview: Drawn from interviews with survivors of Easy Company, as well as their journals and letters, Band of Brothers chronicles the experiences of these men from paratrooper training in Georgia through the end of the war. As an elite rifle company parachuting into Normandy early on D-Day morning, participants in the Battle of the Bulge, and witness to the horrors of war, the men of Easy knew extraordinary bravery and extraordinary fear - and became the stuff of legend. Based on Stephen E. Ambrose's acclaimed book of the same name.
worthSummary: Band of Brothers is a highly acclaimed war drama miniseries that follows the story of Easy Company, a US Army airborne division, during World War II. The series is praised for its realistic and authentic portrayal of war, with many reviewers noting its production quality and emotional impact. The series has received widespread critical acclaim and is considered one of the best war dramas of all time.
worthHighlights: Highly realistic and authentic portrayal of war
worthLowlights: Some reviewers found the sound effects to be slightly inaccurate
A few critics noted that the series can be emotionally challenging to watch

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
originalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​
worthSummary: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King is a visually stunning and emotionally powerful conclusion to the trilogy, with memorable moments and strong character development.
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the pacing slow
Critics of the film's handling of certain plot points

title: The Boys
overview: A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.
worthSummary: "The Boys" is overwhelmingly praised as a brilliant and refreshing antidote to conventional superhero narratives, offering a violent, surprising, and constantly twisting take on the genre. Reviewers found it incredibly engaging, often leading to binge-watching, and appreciated its mature themes and unique dystopian reimagining. It successfully subverts expectations, delivering an exciting and memorable experience for those seeking something different.

title: The Sopranos
overview: The story of New Jersey-based Italian-American mobster Tony Soprano and the difficulties he faces as he tries to balance the conflicting requirements of his home life and the criminal organization he heads. Those difficulties are often highlighted through his ongoing professional relationship with psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi. The show features Tony's family members and Mafia associates in prominent roles and story arcs, most notably his wife Carmela and his cousin and protégé Christopher Moltisanti.
worthSummary: The Sopranos is a highly acclaimed TV series that redefined television with its intelligent writing, first-rate performances, and iconic characters. It follows the life of Tony Soprano, a New Jersey mob boss, as he navigates his work and family life. The show is widely regarded as one of the best TV shows of all-time, with many praising its flawless execution and high quality.
worthHighlights: Redefined television with its innovative storytelling
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the show's pacing slow or uneven
The show's themes and content may be off-putting to some

title: Schindler'in Listesi
overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
worthSummary: Schindler's List is a powerful and emotional film that respectfully honors the victims of the Holocaust. It's a masterpiece that effectively conveys the horrors of the Holocaust without manipulation. The film's use of a red coat as a symbol is particularly impactful.
worthHighlights: A beautifully crafted film about the Holocaust
Respectfully honors every person who died in the Holocaust
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the film's subject matter disturbing
Treatment of the Holocaust is a matter of debate

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
originalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.
worthSummary: The reviews showcase a passionate and emotional response to the film, with some users expressing their love and admiration for the movie, while others are more critical of certain characters.

Mixed opinions on the film's pacing and tone

title: Baba II

worthSummary: The Godfather: Part II is a critically acclaimed film that explores the transformation of Vito Corleone from an idealistic immigrant to a powerful businessman, and his son Michael's rise to power. The film is known for its complex characters, engaging storyline, and exceptional performances. It is widely regarded as one of the greatest sequels in cinema history.
worthHighlights: Exceptional performances from Al Pacino and Robert De Niro
Critically acclaimed and widely regarded as a classic

The film's themes and tone may be challenging for some audiences

title: The Wire
overview: Told from the points of view of both the Baltimore homicide and narcotics detectives and their targets, the series captures a universe in which the national war on drugs has become a permanent, self-sustaining bureaucracy, and distinctions between good and evil are routinely obliterated.
worthSummary: The Wire is a highly acclaimed crime drama series that explores the gritty lives of Baltimore residents, from police officers to gang members, with exceptional writing and acting.
worthHighlights: Gritty portrayal of life in Baltimore
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find it slow-paced
Not all seasons are equally strong

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
overview: In a war-torn world of elemental magic, a young boy reawakens to undertake a dangerous mystic quest to fulfill his destiny as the Avatar, and bring peace to the world.
worthSummary: Avatar: The Last Airbender is a highly acclaimed animated series praised for its philosophical themes, character development, and animation style, with many reviewers considering it a masterpiece.
worthHighlights: Unique blend of American and Japanese animation

Not suitable for all ages due to mature themes

title: ‎Ofis‎

worthSummary: The Office is a highly acclaimed sitcom with a unique blend of humor, heartwarming moments, and well-developed characters. Reviewers praise its relatable portrayal of office life, clever writing, and talented cast. While some appreciate its subtle humor, others mention its potential for irritation.
worthHighlights: Unique blend of humor and heartwarming moments

Some may find the humor too subtle

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
worthSummary: Inception received mixed reviews, with some praising its complex plot and others criticizing its characters and emotional depth. The film's themes and visuals were widely appreciated, but some viewers found it confusing or emotionally unengaging.

title: Fight Club
overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
worthSummary: Fight Club is a complex, thought-provoking film that explores themes of toxic masculinity, consumerism, and rebellion. The movie's dark humor and satire are engaging, but some viewers find it problematic. The film's meaning and intentions are open to interpretation.
worthHighlights: Dark humor and satire are engaging
worthLowlights: Some viewers find it disturbing or off-putting

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.
worthSummary: Forrest Gump is a film that elicits strong reactions, with some viewers praising its nostalgic value and others criticizing its perceived conservative themes and simplistic storytelling.

title: Ucuz Roman
overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three stories that ingeniously trip back and forth in time.
worthSummary: Pulp Fiction is a film with diverse opinions on its value, ranging from appreciation of its life lessons to criticism of its content. Some viewers find it entertaining and memorable, while others are disappointed or confused. The film's eclectic nature sparks debate.
worthLowlights: Some viewers find it overhyped or disappointing

title: Sherlock
overview: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.
worthSummary: Sherlock is a highly acclaimed series that has received widespread critical acclaim for its writing, acting, and direction. It has been praised for its ability to balance humor, drama, and suspense. The show has been described as brilliant, addictive, and a must-watch.
worthHighlights: Faithful adaptation of the original story
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the modern setting jarring
A few critics have noted that the show can be overly reliant on tropes

title: Attack on Titan
overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!
worthSummary: Attack on Titan is a highly acclaimed anime series that has deeply impacted viewers with its intense storyline, emotional connections, and attention to detail. Many reviewers praise its ability to evoke strong emotions and its thought-provoking themes. However, some reviewers note that the series' focus on plot twists and action may overshadow its character development.
worthHighlights: Attention to detail in animation and sound design
worthLowlights: Some reviewers find character development lacking
Overemphasis on action and plot twists

title: Better Call Saul
overview: Six years before Saul Goodman meets Walter White. We meet him when the man who will become Saul Goodman is known as Jimmy McGill, a small-time lawyer searching for his destiny, and, more immediately, hustling to make ends meet. Working alongside, and, often, against Jimmy, is “fixer” Mike Ehrmantraut. The series tracks Jimmy’s transformation into Saul Goodman, the man who puts “criminal” in “criminal lawyer".
worthSummary: Based on user reviews, 'Better Call Saul' is overwhelmingly praised as a masterpiece, frequently hailed as one of the greatest shows of all time and a worthy successor to 'Breaking Bad'. Reviewers consistently highlight its intelligent dialogue, compelling characters, and exceptional storytelling, making it an addictive and highly regarded series. Many consider it a miracle in television, expanding its universe to unparalleled heights.

title: 12 Angry Men
overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open and shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions about the trial, the accused, and each other.
worthSummary: This film is widely praised for its powerful depiction of the justice system and its exploration of prejudice. While some viewers found the pacing slow or the dialogue repetitive, the majority found the film's themes and performances compelling. It's considered a significant cinematic achievement that sparks important conversations.

title: Planet Earth
overview: David Attenborough celebrates the amazing variety of the natural world in this epic documentary series, filmed over four years across 64 different countries.
worthSummary: This series is overwhelmingly praised as a masterpiece of documentary filmmaking, consistently earning perfect scores from viewers. It is lauded for its utterly breathtaking cinematography, groundbreaking visuals, and ability to showcase our planet's wonders as never seen before. Reviewers describe it as an awe-inspiring, mesmerizing, and highly educational experience that sets a new standard for natural history television.
worthLowlights: Some find emphasis on viscous, dark

title: Interstellar

worthSummary: This film elicits incredibly strong emotional responses, with many viewers finding it deeply moving, intense, and even cathartic, particularly regarding themes of paternal relationships. While some humorous criticisms touch upon specific character priorities or casting, the overwhelming sentiment points to a powerful and memorable cinematic experience that leaves a lasting impression. It's described as an emotionally heavy journey that resonates deeply with personal connections.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
originalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
overview: Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at two towers--Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor. Frodo and Sam are trekking to Mordor to destroy the One Ring of Power while Gimli, Legolas and Aragorn search for the orc-captured Merry and Pippin. All along, nefarious wizard Saruman awaits the Fellowship members at the Orthanc Tower in Isengard.
worthSummary: Reviews for "The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers" are overwhelmingly positive, highlighting the film's iconic action sequences and memorable character moments. Viewers particularly praise the spectacle of the Ents' assault on Isengard and Legolas's impressive shield-surfing stunt. The film is also recognized for its significant cultural impact, with many appreciating its humor and visual appeal.

title: Rick and Morty
overview: Follows a sociopathic genius scientist who drags his inherently timid grandson on adventures across the universe.
worthSummary: Rick and Morty is overwhelmingly praised as a smart, hilarious, and original animated comedy. Reviewers consistently highlight its unique blend of sci-fi, emotion, and dark humor, noting its strong appeal to adult audiences. The show is celebrated for its creative writing, strong character dynamics, and consistently fresh episodes, leading many to rewatch it multiple times.

title: Friends
overview: Six young people from New York City, on their own and struggling to survive in the real world, find the companionship, comfort and support they get from each other to be the perfect antidote to the pressures of life.
worthSummary: Based on user reviews, 'Friends' (Friends) is overwhelmingly considered a timeless and beloved sitcom, frequently rewatched and cherished by many. Reviewers consistently praise its enduring humor, relatable characters, and its ability to provide comfort and laughter across generations. It is widely regarded as one of the best sitcoms of all time, with its appeal remaining strong decades after its initial airing.

title: Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.
worthSummary: User reviews overwhelmingly praise this film as a groundbreaking masterpiece, highlighting its intense action sequences and significant cultural impact. Many express profound regret for not experiencing it sooner, while others playfully engage with its iconic themes and character dynamics. Despite one humorous observation about a specific plot point, the consensus points to an unforgettable cinematic experience.

title: Planet Earth II
overview: David Attenborough presents a documentary series exploring how animals meet the challenges of surviving in the most iconic habitats on earth.
worthSummary: The reviews for "Planet Earth II" (Planet Earth II) are unanimously positive, with every critic awarding a perfect score. Viewers consistently praise the series for its astounding visual improvements, superb cinematography, and masterful editing, often noting it surpasses its acclaimed predecessor. David Attenborough's unparalleled narration further elevates the experience, making it an awe-inspiring and mesmerizing watch.

title: Stranger Things
overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.
worthSummary: Stranger Things is widely celebrated as a captivating and highly entertaining series that lives up to its considerable hype. Many viewers were pleasantly surprised by its intense drama, immersive storytelling, and successful homage to 1980s supernatural thrillers, often leading to binge-watching and high rewatchability. While some feel the first season remains the strongest, the show is consistently praised for its overall quality and ability to exceed expectations.

title: Arcane
overview: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.
worthSummary: Arcane is overwhelmingly praised as a visually stunning and artistically groundbreaking series, captivating both long-time fans of the source material and newcomers alike. Critics highlight its engaging storytelling, intricate world-building, and mature themes that defy initial impressions of a "kids show." The series is consistently lauded for its exceptional animation, stellar voice acting, and impactful musical score, making it a highly recommended watch.

title: The Empire Strikes Back
overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

Viewers express intense positive reactions, suggesting it holds up remarkably well over time. While one review humorously mentions an "unnecessary sex scene," the overall sentiment is one of strong enjoyment and high regard.

title: GoodFellas

worthSummary: The collected reviews overwhelmingly praise the film, highlighting its iconic cinematic moments, memorable dialogue, and powerful character portrayals. Viewers particularly appreciate the strong direction, engaging narrative, and the cool, intense atmosphere created by the performances and soundtrack. While some observations note an age discrepancy in casting or the volatile nature of relationships depicted, these are presented more as descriptive elements than criticisms, reinforcing the film's impactful and raw portrayal of its world.

title: Yedi
overview: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
worthSummary: Reviews for "Yedi" overwhelmingly praise its intense and impactful storytelling, highlighting David Fincher's masterful direction and the film's ability to create a deeply unsettling atmosphere from its opening scenes. Viewers frequently commend the strong performances from the main cast, with special mention of the memorable and powerful ending. The film is noted for its lasting psychological effect and sophisticated cinematic techniques, leaving a significant impression on its audience.

title: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
originalTitle: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
overview: While the Civil War rages on between the Union and the Confederacy, three men – a quiet loner, a ruthless hitman, and a Mexican bandit – comb the American Southwest in search of a strongbox containing $200,000 in stolen gold.

Reviewers highlight specific iconic scenes and strong performances, especially from Eli Wallach. Many consider it their favorite movie, noting its enduring appeal and unexpected buddy-comedy elements set during the Civil War.

title: One Piece
overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!
worthSummary: One Piece (1999) receives overwhelming praise, with reviewers consistently rating it as a top-tier anime. Its core appeal lies in its strong themes of friendship (nakama), hilarious humor, and thrilling action set within a vibrant pirate world. While the infamous 4Kids English dub is widely criticized, the original Japanese version is celebrated for its exceptional quality and enduring appeal, making it a beloved series for many.

title: True Detective
overview: An American anthology police detective series utilizing multiple timelines in which investigations seem to unearth personal and professional secrets of those involved, both within or outside the law.
worthSummary: True Detective is overwhelmingly praised, with its first season frequently hailed as a masterpiece of television. Reviewers consistently highlight the phenomenal acting, brilliant writing, and compelling storytelling of Season 1. While subsequent seasons are considered watchable, they are generally seen as a significant drop in quality compared to the acclaimed debut.

title: Seinfeld
overview: A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.
worthSummary: Seinfeld is overwhelmingly praised as one of the greatest and best-written sitcoms in television history, consistently lauded for its enduring humor and unique 'show about nothing' premise. Reviewers highlight its ability to remain hilarious and relevant decades after its initial run, with many considering it a cultural landmark. The series is celebrated for its genius writing, memorable characters, and an ensemble cast where all co-stars are equally funny.

title: Peaky Blinders
overview: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.
worthSummary: Based on user reviews, "Peaky Blinders" is overwhelmingly praised as a captivating and unforgettable series. Critics highlight its gritty drama, stunning cinematography, and a unique atmosphere that draws viewers in from the start. Cillian Murphy's performance as Tommy Shelby is consistently singled out as phenomenal and magnetic, anchoring a masterclass in storytelling with complex characters.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
originalTitle: 鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST
overview: Disregard for alchemy’s laws ripped half of Edward Elric’s limbs from his body and left his brother Alphonse’s soul clinging to a suit of armor. Enemies and allies – the corrupt military, the Homunculi, and foreign alchemists – will alter the Elric brothers course, but their purpose will remain unchanged and their bond unbreakable.
worthSummary: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood is overwhelmingly praised by users, frequently hailed as a masterpiece and one of the best animated series ever. Reviewers consistently highlight its exceptional storytelling, well-developed and engaging characters, and high-quality animation and voice acting. Many consider it a superior adaptation of the manga, appealing even to those who typically don't watch anime, making it a highly recommended watch.
worthHighlights: Broad appeal, even for non-anime fans

title: DEATH NOTE
overview: Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god. Any human whose name is written in the notebook dies, and Light has vowed to use the power of the Death Note to rid the world of evil. But will Light succeed in his noble goal, or will the Death Note turn him into the very thing he fights against?
worthSummary: DEATH NOTE is widely celebrated as a brilliant and captivating series, particularly its first half, which features intense psychological warfare and a clever, suspenseful narrative. Many reviewers praise its well-developed characters and unpredictable storyline, considering it a refreshing departure from typical action anime. However, a consistent criticism highlights a noticeable decline in quality and tension in the latter half, with some finding it merely "okay" compared to the exceptional beginning.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
overview: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.
worthSummary: This film generates strong, polarized reactions, with many praising its intense third act and an iconic, chilling final line that solidifies its place in cinema history. It's recognized for its memorable characters and impactful narrative. However, potential viewers should be aware of deeply disturbing and graphic content that some find extremely unsettling, leading to very strong emotional discomfort.

title: Saving Private Ryan
overview: As U.S. troops storm the beaches of Normandy, three brothers lie dead on the battlefield, with a fourth trapped behind enemy lines. Ranger captain John Miller and seven men are tasked with penetrating German-held territory and bringing the boy home.
worthSummary: This film is widely acclaimed for its groundbreaking and visceral portrayal of warfare, with many praising its intense, harrowing sequences and powerful emotional impact. It's noted for redefining the combat genre and leaving a lasting impression on viewers, often evoking strong, even frustrating, emotional responses. However, some critics question the ultimate worth of the central mission or find specific character actions vexing. Despite these points, the overwhelming sentiment points to a significant and impactful cinematic experience.

title: Star Wars
overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
worthSummary: The collected reviews for "Star Wars" are overwhelmingly positive, highlighting the film's enduring appeal and memorable moments. Viewers praise its iconic characters, humorous interactions, and the sheer enjoyment it provides, even prompting spontaneous rewatches. The sentiment is one of deep affection and appreciation for its classic status.

title: The Green Mile
overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.
worthSummary: Despite its length, viewers found "The Green Mile" to be a fantastic and emotionally resonant film that flies by. Many praised its powerful performances and ability to evoke strong emotions, even if some characters were less likable than others.

title: House, M.D.
overview: Dr. Gregory House, a drug-addicted, unconventional, misanthropic medical genius, leads a team of diagnosticians at the fictional Princeton–Plainsboro Teaching Hospital in New Jersey.
worthSummary: House, M.D. is widely praised as an intelligent and captivating medical drama, distinguished by its anti-hero protagonist and compelling mysteries. While some acknowledge medical inaccuracies, the show's brilliance in character acting, particularly Hugh Laurie's performance, and its unique approach to the genre make it a standout program for many viewers.

title: Black Mirror
overview: Twisted tales run wild in this mind-bending anthology series that reveals humanity's worst traits, greatest innovations and more.
worthSummary: Black Mirror is widely praised as an original and thought-provoking anthology series, often exploring the darker side of technology's impact on society. While earlier seasons are frequently lauded as masterpieces, some later seasons have drawn criticism for deviating from the show's core premise. Despite some inconsistencies, the series is generally considered a compelling watch for its unique concept and often stunning execution.

title: Dexter
overview: Dexter Morgan, a blood spatter pattern analyst for the Miami Metro Police also leads a secret life as a serial killer, hunting down criminals who have slipped through the cracks of justice.
worthSummary: Dexter is widely praised as a highly addictive and masterfully crafted crime drama. Viewers are captivated by its complex characters, particularly Michael C. worthLowlights: Some scenes may be off-putting or disturbing

title: Can Dostum
overview: Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who is failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will's last chance is a psychology professor, who might be the only man who can reach him.
worthSummary: A film with polarizing opinions, 'Can Dostum' (1997) has received mixed reviews, with some praising Robin Williams' performance and others criticizing the screenplay and janitorial inaccuracies.

title: Psycho
overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.
worthSummary: A 1960 Turkish drama film exploring themes of masculinity, mental illness, and societal norms. The film features a unique blend of drama and social commentary. Critics praise the film's thought-provoking and emotionally charged storytelling.
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the film's pacing slow

title: Modern Family
overview: The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan is a wonderfully large and blended family. They give us an honest and often hilarious look into the sometimes warm, sometimes twisted, embrace of the modern family.
worthSummary: Modern Family is a highly acclaimed sitcom with a talented ensemble cast, witty writing, and relatable characters. It explores themes of family, love, and acceptance in a humorous and heartwarming way. While some critics note a decline in quality in later seasons, the show remains a beloved and entertaining watch.
worthLowlights: Decline in quality in later seasons

title: The Twilight Zone
overview: An anthology series containing drama, psychological thriller, fantasy, science fiction, suspense, and/or horror, often concluding with a macabre or unexpected twist.
worthSummary: The Twilight Zone is a classic anthology series that explores science fiction, fantasy, and social commentary through unique and imaginative storytelling. It has stood the test of time and remains a relevant and influential work in the genre. The series has a wide range of episodes, each with its own twist and moral.
worthHighlights: Wide range of imaginative and thought-provoking episodes
Aged extremely well and remains influential
worthLowlights: Some episodes may feel dated or slow-paced
Not all episodes are equally strong or memorable

title: Joker
overview: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.
worthSummary: Joker is a bold, transgressive, and thought-provoking film that sparks intense debate. However, it also raises concerns about its portrayal of mental illness and its potential impact on audiences. The film's originality and cinematography are notable, but its themes and tone are divisive.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
overview: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.
worthSummary: Raiders of the Lost Ark is a classic adventure film that balances pulp nostalgia with technical expertise, featuring a memorable villain and impressive action sequences.

title: Mad Men
overview: Set in 1960-1970 New York, this sexy, stylized and provocative drama follows the lives of the ruthlessly competitive men and women of Madison Avenue advertising.
worthSummary: Mad Men is a critically acclaimed series that explores the lives of advertising professionals in the 1960s, known for its complex characters, subtle storytelling, and historical context.
worthHighlights: Deep character development and complex relationships
Subtle storytelling with a strong focus on subtext
worthLowlights: Some viewers may find the pacing slow initially
Not all characters are equally well-developed

title: The Queen's Gambit
overview: In a 1950s orphanage, a young girl reveals an astonishing talent for chess and begins an unlikely journey to stardom while grappling with addiction.
worthSummary: The Queen's Gambit is a highly acclaimed Netflix series with exceptional writing, directing, and acting. It has a strong narrative and character development, making it a compelling watch. The series has received widespread critical acclaim and is worth watching.
worthLowlights: Some viewers found the opening episode weak
A few critics felt that some characters deserved more development

title: Yellowstone
overview: Follow the violent world of the Dutton family, who controls the largest contiguous ranch in the United States. Led by their patriarch John Dutton, the family defends their property against constant attack by land developers, an Indian reservation, and America’s first National Park.
worthSummary: Yellowstone is a gripping show with well-developed characters, beautiful cinematography, and a sweeping storyline. However, it declines in quality over time and becomes predictable. Despite its flaws, it remains a compelling watch.

title: Kazablanka
overview: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
worthSummary: Casablanca is a classic film with a timeless story, memorable characters, and iconic dialogue. It explores themes of love, sacrifice, and loyalty during World War II. The film's pacing and performances are well-regarded, but some viewers find the characters' choices and relationships unconvincing.
worthLowlights: Some viewers find characters' choices unconvincing
Characters' relationships can be hard to believe

title: Curb Your Enthusiasm
overview: The off-kilter, unscripted comic vision of Larry David, who plays himself in a parallel universe in which he can't seem to do anything right, and, by his standards, neither can anyone else.
worthSummary: Curb Your Enthusiasm is a comedy series that receives widespread acclaim for its humor, realism, and genius writing. However, some viewers may find it polarizing due to its improv style and lack of a traditional storyline. Overall, it's a well-crafted and entertaining show.
worthHighlights: One of the best sitcoms of all time
worthLowlights: Improv style may be an acquired taste

title: Severance
overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.
worthSummary: Severance is overwhelmingly lauded as a brilliant, unique, and deeply engaging series that captivates viewers from the very first episode. Critics consistently praise its exceptional directing, stunning visuals, compelling acting, and thought-provoking plot, often drawing favorable comparisons to other acclaimed dystopian works. While the first season's ending left some viewers frustrated by its unresolved nature, the overall sentiment is one of intense satisfaction and a strong desire for more, with the series refusing to rush explanations.

title: Twin Peaks
overview: The body of Laura Palmer is washed up on a beach near the small Washington state town of Twin Peaks. FBI Special Agent Dale Cooper is called in to investigate her strange demise only to uncover a web of mystery that ultimately leads him deep into the heart of the surrounding woodland and his very own soul.
worthSummary: Based on user reviews, "Twin Peaks" is overwhelmingly considered a groundbreaking and unique television masterpiece. Viewers consistently praise its hypnotic atmosphere, iconic opening, and daring narrative that shattered traditional TV drama boundaries. While some note minor imperfections or a stark cliffhanger ending, the series is widely celebrated for its intelligence and originality, often cited as an all-time favorite.

title: Yedi Samuray
overview: A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.
worthSummary: Yedi Samuray is overwhelmingly praised as a monumental and enduring cinematic achievement, with reviewers expressing awe at its quality and lasting impact. Despite its age, the film is lauded for feeling remarkably modern and capable of competing with contemporary action films. Its visual mastery, authentic portrayal of violence, and powerful, influential storytelling are consistently highlighted, often overcoming any initial skepticism about its considerable length.

title: MINDHUNTER
overview: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.
worthSummary: Mindhunter is overwhelmingly praised as a brilliant and exceptionally well-crafted series, lauded for its perfect pacing, strong character development, and outstanding acting. Viewers deeply appreciate its unique approach to the origins of FBI profiling, drawing from real criminal cases and offering a compelling narrative. The primary disappointment expressed by the community is the show's cancellation, leaving many clamoring for a third season despite its high quality.

title: Downton Abbey
overview: A chronicle of the lives of the aristocratic Crawley family and their servants in the post-Edwardian era—with great events in history having an effect on their lives and on the British social hierarchy.
worthSummary: Downton Abbey is overwhelmingly praised as a captivating and beautifully produced British period drama. Reviewers highlight its ability to hook audiences quickly, its stellar cast—particularly Maggie Smith—and its engaging character relationships. The series is lauded for its historical accuracy and refined storytelling, appealing even to viewers outside its typical demographic.

title: Naruto: Shippuuden
overview: After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work. It will not be easy though as he has amassed a few more dangerous enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki.
worthSummary: Reviews for "Naruto: Shippuuden" are overwhelmingly positive, hailing it as one of the best anime series available. Viewers consistently praise its epic fights, deep emotional storytelling, and unpredictable plot twists, alongside exceptional character development. Many found the series profoundly impactful and engaging, often considering it superior to other popular anime titles.

title: Shameless
overview: Chicagoan Frank Gallagher is the proud single dad of six smart, industrious, independent kids, who without him would be... perhaps better off. When Frank's not at the bar spending what little money they have, he's passed out on the floor. But the kids have found ways to grow up in spite of him. They may not be like any family you know, but they make no apologies for being exactly who they are.
worthSummary: Shameless is widely regarded as a compelling and beloved comedy-drama, celebrated for its portrayal of a dysfunctional family that sticks together. Many viewers express a deep affection for the series and miss it since its conclusion. However, a consistent criticism highlights a significant decline in quality and loss of steam in its later seasons, particularly after a key character's departure, leading some to feel it overstayed its welcome.
worthLowlights: Not same after key character left

title: Suits
overview: While running from a drug deal gone bad, Mike Ross, a brilliant young college-dropout, slips into a job interview with one of New York City's best legal closers, Harvey Specter. Tired of cookie-cutter law school grads, Harvey takes a gamble by hiring Mike on the spot after he recognizes his raw talent and photographic memory.
worthSummary: Suits is overwhelmingly praised as an addictive and highly entertaining legal drama, distinguished by its exceptional character chemistry and smart, witty writing. Many viewers consider it their favorite lawyer show, highlighting its ability to capture attention from the start. While one review suggested it might have run a season too long, it consistently delivered a strong and satisfying conclusion, cementing its status as a beloved series.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
originalTitle: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
overview: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.
worthSummary: The premiere of "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" is overwhelmingly praised for its character-driven narrative and return to a more grounded Westeros, reminiscent of early Game of Thrones. Reviewers highlight the strong chemistry between the leads, well-written characters, and a refreshing blend of humor and realism. While some noted the episode's shorter length and slower initial pace, the overall sentiment is highly positive, with many considering it a significant improvement over previous spin-offs.

title: Aliens
overview: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.
worthSummary: This film is overwhelmingly praised for its thrilling action, iconic characters, and unique blend of sci-fi and intense maternal protectiveness. Reviewers particularly highlight the strong female lead and the memorable "found family" dynamic, often with a humorous appreciation for its direct, action-packed approach. The shift in tone from its predecessor is noted humorously, but not as a detraction, indicating a highly engaging and impactful viewing experience.

title: Arrested Development
overview: The story of a wealthy family that lost everything, and the one son who had no choice but to keep them all together.
worthSummary: Arrested Development is widely celebrated as an incredibly funny and smart sitcom, with its initial three seasons frequently hailed as some of the best television comedy ever made. Reviewers praise its unique characters, fantastic cast chemistry, and hilarious writing. While the series is highly recommended, there's a strong consensus that the Netflix revival seasons (4 and 5) experienced a significant drop in quality and are often considered disappointing.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
overview: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he loves most.
worthSummary: User reviews for 'Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse' are overwhelmingly positive, highlighting an incredibly dense and visually stunning experience that leaves viewers 'flabbergasted and overstimulated' in the best possible way. Critics praise its animation, vibrant colors, humor, and soundtrack as near-perfect, often leading to profound emotional reactions. While intensely fast-paced, the film is widely regarded as a magical, outstanding achievement that sets a new bar for animated cinema. Many found it an unforgettable and deeply enjoyable cinematic event.

title: Up
overview: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.
worthSummary: The film "Up" (Up) is overwhelmingly praised for its incredibly powerful and emotionally resonant opening sequence, often cited as a masterclass in storytelling that brings many viewers to tears. While the initial minutes are almost universally lauded for their profound impact and ability to introduce complex emotions, some critics suggest that the rest of the film, though still an enjoyable adventure with charming characters, doesn't quite maintain the same thematic depth or cohesion as its brilliant beginning.

title: American Beauty
overview: Lester Burnham, a depressed suburban father in a mid-life crisis, decides to turn his hectic life around after developing an infatuation with his daughter's attractive friend.
worthSummary: The reviews are overwhelmingly critical, highlighting the film's disturbing and problematic themes, particularly the protagonist's pedophilic desires. Many found the characters and overall tone unsettling and cynical, with some suggesting the only redeeming quality was a violent end for the lead. While some noted its exploration of rebellion and impactful character portrayals, the content is largely viewed with discomfort and strong disapproval.

title: Clarkson's Farm
overview: Follow Jeremy Clarkson as he embarks on his latest adventure, farming. The man who on several occasions claims to be allergic to manual labour takes on the most manually labour intensive job there is. What could possibly go wrong?
worthSummary: The series "Clarkson's Farm" is overwhelmingly praised by users as "pure gold" and "top quality entertainment." Reviewers highlight its authentic portrayal of farming life, the engaging personalities including Clarkson himself, and its surprising ability to win over even initial skeptics. Despite external criticism mentioned and dismissed by reviewers, the show is celebrated for its genuine charm, informative content, and high entertainment value, with many eagerly anticipating future seasons.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
overview: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.
worthSummary: This film garners overwhelming praise for its innovative and stunning animation, which many reviewers laud as groundbreaking. Critics highlight its creative storytelling, humor, and deep understanding of the Spider-Man character, noting its ability to reinvigorate the superhero genre. It is also lauded for its exceptional rewatchability, with no negative criticisms reported across the reviews.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
originalTitle: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
overview: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend underwent a procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. However, as he watches his memories of her fade away, he realises that he still loves her, and may be too late to correct his mistake.
worthSummary: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind is consistently described as a profoundly impactful and emotionally devastating film that leaves a lasting impression on its audience. Reviewers praise its perfect portrayal of complex relationships and the pain of heartbreak, often wishing they could experience it for the first time again. It deeply resonates with themes of memory, loss, and the human search for peace of mind.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
overview: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking world and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.
worthSummary: The Wolf of Wall Street is widely lauded as an undiluted, intense, and often shocking cinematic experience, with particular praise for Leonardo DiCaprio's powerful performance. While some viewers offer humorous observations on its exaggerated characters and themes, the film is celebrated for its wild energy and Martin Scorsese's masterful direction. It's considered a memorable and impactful watch, despite its chaotic nature.

title: The West Wing
overview: The West Wing provides a glimpse into presidential politics in the nation's capital as it tells the stories of the members of a fictional presidential administration. These interesting characters have humor and dedication that touches the heart while the politics that they discuss touch on everyday life.
worthSummary: The West Wing is overwhelmingly lauded by viewers as a monumental achievement in television, frequently described as "as good as TV gets." Reviewers consistently praise its brilliant writing, acting, production, and direction, often calling it faultless from the outset. Many found the series incredibly engaging and addictive, with its quality appealing even to those outside the US or those not typically interested in politics.

title: Gizli Dosyalar
overview: The exploits of FBI Special Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully who investigate X-Files: marginalized, unsolved cases involving paranormal phenomena. Mulder believes in the existence of aliens and the paranormal while Scully, a skeptic, is assigned to make scientific analyses of Mulder's discoveries that debunk Mulder's work and thus return him to mainstream cases.
worthSummary: This series is overwhelmingly praised as a groundbreaking and intelligent sci-fi masterpiece, lauded for its intricate plots, compelling character dynamic between Mulder and Scully, and its unique blend of sci-fi, thriller, and mystery. Reviewers highlight its enduring entertainment value, particularly the perfect writing in its early seasons, and its ability to create an eerie, captivating atmosphere. It's considered a highly influential show that has stood the test of time.

title: Oyuncak Hikayesi
overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
worthSummary: Toy Story is widely praised as a masterclass in animation and screenwriting, with many considering it one of the best and most cleverly written animated films ever made. Its tight script and relatable themes, even touching on existential crises, contribute to its enduring appeal. The film is seen as a benchmark for storytelling that remains relevant and impactful decades later.

title: Fleabag
overview: A portrait into the mind of a dry-witted, sexual, angry, porn-watching, grief-riddled woman, trying to make sense of the world. As she hurls herself headlong at modern living, Fleabag is thrown roughly up against the walls of contemporary London, with all its frenetic energy, late nights, and bright lights.
worthSummary: Fleabag is widely praised as exceptional television, lauded for its brilliant storytelling, sharp humor, and poignant emotional depth. While some find its unique comedic style divisive, the overwhelming sentiment is that it's a deeply funny, relatable, and masterfully crafted series that resonates strongly with viewers.

title: Freaks and Geeks
overview: High school mathlete Lindsay Weir rebels and begins hanging out with a crowd of burnouts (the "freaks"), while her brother Sam Weir navigates a different part of the social universe with his nerdy friends (the "geeks").
worthSummary: Freaks and Geeks is widely praised as a remarkably well-written and acted series that perfectly captures the authentic experience of high school life and parenthood. Despite its critical acclaim and relatable portrayal of teenage years, the show was unfortunately canceled prematurely. Viewers consistently express bewilderment at its short run, highlighting its wit and the perfect casting.

title: Return of the Jedi
overview: Luke Skywalker leads a mission to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of Jabba the Hutt, the Emperor prepares to crush the Rebellion with a more powerful Death Star, and the Rebel fleet mounts a massive attack on the space station. Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader in a final climactic duel before the evil Emperor.
worthSummary: While some viewers find the film to be a disappointing conclusion, others appreciate its iconic moments and character arcs. The Ewoks and Luke Skywalker's fashion choices are frequent points of discussion, sometimes humorous, sometimes critical. Despite its flaws, the movie offers memorable exchanges and a significant place in cinematic history.

title: Mr. Robot
overview: A young programmer, Elliot, suffers from a debilitating anti-social disorder and decides that he can only connect to people by hacking them. He wields his skills as a weapon to protect the people that he cares about. Elliot finds himself in the intersection between a cybersecurity firm he works for and the underworld organizations that are recruiting him to bring down corporate America.
worthSummary: Mr. Robot is widely praised as a unique and masterfully directed series with compelling characters and an unpredictable plot. Many viewers found the final episodes particularly impactful, describing the show as a life-changing experience. While some note similarities to Fight Club, the series is generally considered a standout with brilliant performances.

title: Reservoir Dogs
overview: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime begets violence as the survivors -- veteran Mr. White, newcomer Mr. Orange, psychopathic parolee Mr. Blonde, bickering weasel Mr. Pink and Nice Guy Eddie -- unravel.
worthSummary: This film resonates deeply with viewers, evoking strong emotional responses and memorable character moments. Many appreciate its unique blend of dark humor and poignant tragedy, particularly the performances. The film's impact lingers, prompting reflection on its themes and character dynamics long after viewing.

title: Parks and Recreation
overview: In an attempt to beautify her town — and advance her career — Leslie Knope, a mid-level bureaucrat in the Parks and Recreation Department of Pawnee, Indiana, takes on bureaucrats, cranky neighbors, and single-issue fanatics whose weapons are lawsuits, the jumble of city codes, and the democratic process she loves so much.
worthSummary: Parks and Recreation is widely praised for its exceptional character development, sharp humor, and genuine heart, with many viewers finding it a consistently enjoyable and rewatchable series. The ensemble cast and their unique personalities are frequently highlighted as a major strength, contributing to both comedic and emotional moments. While the early episodes might require some patience, the show is overwhelmingly recommended for its uplifting and hilarious portrayal of workplace dynamics.

title: Apocalypse Now
overview: At the height of the Vietnam war, Captain Benjamin Willard is sent on a dangerous mission that, officially, "does not exist, nor will it ever exist." His goal is to locate - and eliminate - a mysterious Green Beret Colonel named Walter Kurtz, who has been leading his personal army on illegal guerrilla missions into enemy territory.
worthSummary: This film is hailed as a profound cinematic achievement, praised for its powerful cinematography and evocative atmosphere that captures the psychological toll of war. Reviewers highlight its impactful use of imagery and sound to convey themes of insanity and the futility of conflict. The film is noted for its unforgettable moments and its ability to evoke strong emotional responses.

title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.
worthSummary: Reviews for "Dune: Part Two" are sharply divided, with some viewers finding it a profoundly moving and visually stunning experience that rekindles faith. Others, however, express strong negative reactions, focusing on bizarre character interactions and perceived absurdity. The film clearly elicits strong emotions, but not always in the way intended by the filmmakers.

title: Braveheart
overview: Enraged at the slaughter of Murron, his new bride and childhood love, Scottish warrior William Wallace slays a platoon of the local English lord's soldiers. This leads the village to revolt and, eventually, the entire country to rise up against English rule.
worthSummary: While "Braveheart" is widely criticized for its significant historical inaccuracies, many viewers find it to be a captivating and powerful cinematic experience. Mel Gibson's direction and passion for filmmaking shine through, making it an entertaining watch despite its factual liberties. The film's spectacle and emotional impact often outweigh its historical shortcomings for many.

title: Batman Begins
overview: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City.  Unable to work within the system, he instead creates a new identity, a symbol of fear for the criminal underworld - The Batman.
worthSummary: Reviews for "Batman Begins" are mixed, with some praising specific elements like Cillian Murphy's performance and cheekbones, and others finding the lead character difficult to take seriously. The film's iconic moments and potential for humor are noted, but the overall impact seems to divide audiences.
worthLowlights: Bruce Wayne is hard to take seriously

title: When They See Us
overview: Five teens from Harlem become trapped in a nightmare when they're falsely accused of a brutal attack in Central Park.
worthSummary: This series is overwhelmingly praised for its powerful storytelling and exceptional acting, particularly from the young cast. Viewers found it deeply moving, evoking strong emotions like sadness and anger, while highlighting its continued relevance. It's considered a significant and impactful production that sheds light on a tragic miscarriage of justice.

title: The Crown
overview:
The gripping, decades-spanning inside story of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II and the Prime Ministers who shaped Britain's post-war destiny. 

The Crown tells the inside story of two of the most famous addresses in the world – Buckingham Palace and 10 Downing Street – and the intrigues, love lives and machinations behind the great events that shaped the second half of the 20th century. Two houses, two courts, one Crown.
worthSummary: The Crown is widely praised as a brilliant and epic piece of television, lauded for its exceptional writing, acting, and stunning production values. Despite initial hesitations from some viewers regarding its subject matter, the series is recognized for its historical interest and broad appeal. It's considered a high-quality drama that demands attention and is consistently ranked among the best television dramas.

title: Coco
overview: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.
worthSummary: Reviewers overwhelmingly found "Coco" to be an emotionally resonant and deeply moving film, despite its heavy themes. Many were unexpectedly moved to tears early on and throughout the movie, praising its heartwarming and powerful narrative. The film's ability to tackle complex subjects like death and family in a touching way was frequently highlighted.

title: Shutter Island
overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.
worthSummary: This film appears to be a thought-provoking thriller that engages viewers with its twists and turns. Many appreciate the performances, particularly Leonardo DiCaprio's, and the film's ability to create a sense of unease and mystery. The narrative's clever construction and the underlying philosophical questions it poses seem to resonate strongly with audiences.

title: Sons of Anarchy
overview: The Sons of Anarchy (SOA) are an outlaw motorcycle club with many charters in the United States and overseas. The show focused on the original and founding charter, Sons of Anarchy Motorcycle Club, Redwood Original, often referred to by the acronym SAMCRO, Sam Crow, or simply Redwood Charter. The charter operates both legal and illegal businesses in the small town of Charming, California. They combine gun-running and a garage, and involvement in porn film industry. Clay, the charter president, likes it old school and violent; while Jax, his stepson and the club's VP, has thoughts about changing the way things are done. Their conflict has effects on both the club and their personal relationship, especially when Jax goes on a personal quest to cleanse the SAMCRO name and image.
worthSummary: Sons of Anarchy is a highly addictive and gripping series that has captivated many viewers. The show is praised for its incredible cast, particularly Charlie Hunnam as Jax Teller, and its compelling, twist-filled plot. Despite its dark themes and emotional toll, the series is considered a favorite by many and is often rewatched.

title: Scarface
overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
worthSummary: Scarface is described as an exhilarating and impactful cinematic experience, with one reviewer calling it the 'best movie ever made.' While the film's excess and violence are noted, they contribute to its powerful, albeit overwhelming, narrative. The sheer scale of Tony Montana's ambition and downfall resonates deeply with viewers, even if the viewing experience can be intense.

title: This Is Us
overview: Follows the lives and families of three adults living and growing up in the United States of America in present and past times. As their paths cross and their life stories intertwine in curious ways, we find that several of them share the same birthday - and so much more than anyone would expect.
worthSummary: This series is widely praised for its emotional depth, realistic portrayal of human relationships, and strong writing. Viewers found it to be a touching and often tear-jerking experience that resonates deeply. Despite occasional criticisms about pacing or character focus, the overall sentiment is that it's a compelling and worthwhile watch.
worthLowlights: Can be overly sentimental at times

title: Andor
overview: In an era filled with danger, deception and intrigue, Cassian Andor will discover the difference he can make in the struggle against the tyrannical Galactic Empire. He embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a rebel hero.
worthSummary: Andor is widely praised as a mature and masterfully crafted Star Wars series, with many considering it the best in the franchise. Reviewers highlight its exceptional writing, acting, and cinematic qualities, appealing to fans seeking a more adult-oriented story. Despite some minor criticisms regarding pacing and time skips, the overwhelming sentiment is that it's a must-watch.

title: Roma
overview: A down-to-earth account of the lives of both illustrious and ordinary Romans set in the last days of the Roman Republic.
worthSummary: This series is overwhelmingly praised as a historically detailed, captivating, and masterfully produced show. Reviewers consistently highlight its engaging storylines, attention to detail, and the compelling performances of its leads. Despite its relatively short run, it's considered a standout in historical television and a must-watch for fans of the genre.

title: Hayat
overview: David Attenborough looks at the extraordinary ends to which animals and plants go in order to survive. Featuring epic spectacles, amazing TV firsts and examples of new wildlife behaviour.
worthSummary: This documentary series is overwhelmingly praised for its stunning cinematography and insightful presentation of the diversity of life on Earth. Narrated by David Attenborough, it offers incredible footage and fascinating facts that have left viewers amazed. While not explicitly stated as perfect, the series is considered a standout achievement in nature documentaries.

title: Westworld
overview: A dark odyssey about the dawn of artificial consciousness and the evolution of sin. Set at the intersection of the near future and the reimagined past, it explores a world in which every human appetite, no matter how noble or depraved, can be indulged.
worthSummary: Westworld begins with an incredibly strong and highly praised first season, often cited as one of the best sci-fi shows ever created. However, subsequent seasons, particularly 3 and 4, are widely considered to suffer a significant decline in quality, shifting from complex sci-fi to a more generic action thriller. While some viewers found merit in the later arcs, the general consensus points to a divisive experience beyond the initial season, with many recommending to stop after Season 1 or 2.

title: Battlestar Galactica
overview: When an old enemy, the Cylons, resurface and obliterate the 12 colonies, the crew of the aged Galactica protect a small civilian fleet - the last of humanity - as they journey toward the fabled 13th colony, Earth.
worthSummary: Battlestar Galactica (2004) is overwhelmingly lauded as a deeply philosophical and captivating sci-fi series. Reviewers consistently praise its excellent writing, complex characters, and mature themes that explore humanity, politics, and survival. While some note that the special effects may not be its strongest suit, the compelling narrative and intense drama are cited as reasons it's considered a must-watch and a cult classic.

title: 葬送のフリーレン
overview: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude.  Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity’s mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends’ dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.
worthSummary: This series is overwhelmingly praised as a profound, philosophical, and heartwarming anime that masterfully explores themes of time, memory, and understanding humanity through an immortal protagonist. Reviewers laud its unique, unconventional narrative that revitalizes the fantasy genre, coupled with exceptional character development and stunning visual and audio presentation. Despite an initially slow pace, the story is celebrated for its depth and emotional impact, making it a highly recommended watch.

title: How I Met Your Mother
overview: A father recounts to his children - through a series of flashbacks - the journey he and his four best friends took leading up to him meeting their mother.
worthSummary: How I Met Your Mother is widely celebrated for its memorable characters, sharp wit, and emotional depth, with many viewers forming strong connections to the gang. While early seasons are often lauded as fantastic, some note a decline in quality in later seasons. The series' ending is a significant point of contention and disappointment for a large portion of its audience. Despite this, the show is largely considered a beloved and impactful sitcom.
worthLowlights: Perceived dip in later season quality

title: Oyuncak Hikayesi 3
overview: Woody, Buzz, and the rest of Andy's toys haven't been played with in years. With Andy about to go to college, the gang find themselves accidentally left at a nefarious day care center. The toys must band together to escape and return home to Andy.
worthSummary: The film is widely praised for its profound emotional impact, with many reviewers highlighting its ability to evoke strong feelings, even from adults. Critics commend its thoroughly enjoyable and rich story, featuring a fantastic villain, elaborate plot elements like a prison escape, and great humor. While one reviewer noted it might not surpass its predecessor, the consensus points to a powerful and moving experience, particularly regarding its ending and thematic depth.

title: Prison Break
overview: Due to a political conspiracy, an innocent man is sent to death row and his only hope is his brother, who makes it his mission to deliberately get himself sent to the same prison in order to break the both of them out, from the inside out.
worthSummary: The series "Prison Break" is overwhelmingly praised as a captivating and addictive thriller, lauded for its brilliant writing, fast-paced action, and stylish execution. Reviewers consistently highlight the strong performances from its superb cast, particularly Wentworth Miller and Dominic Purcell, and the memorable character development. Its ingenious premise and the loyalty between characters contribute to an edge-of-your-seat viewing experience that keeps audiences hooked throughout its run.

title: Vinland Saga
overview: For a thousand years, the Vikings have made quite a name and reputation for themselves as the strongest families with a thirst for violence. Thorfinn, the son of one of the Vikings' greatest warriors, spends his boyhood in a battlefield enhancing his skills in his adventure to redeem his most-desired revenge after his father was murdered.
worthSummary: Vinland Saga is overwhelmingly praised as a unique and deeply impactful series, lauded for its exceptional animation, incredible storytelling, and profoundly real characters. Reviewers highlight its evolving narrative, transitioning from an action-adventure to a remarkable psychological drama focused on character growth and rebirth. The show is consistently described as an outstanding experience with significant emotional resonance, poised to become a classic.

title: Only Fools and Horses
overview:
Only Fools and Horses.... Is a British sitcom created and written by John Sullivan. Seven series were originally transmitted on BBC One from 1981 to 1991, with sixteen sporadic Christmas specials aired until 2003.

In working-class Peckham in south-east London, ambitious market trader Derek 'Del Boy' Trotter and his younger half-brother Rodney, explore their highs and lows in life, in particular their attempts to get rich.

Initially not an immediate hit and receiving little promotion early on, it later achieved consistently high ratings, and the 1996 episode "Time on Our Hands" (originally billed as the series finale) holds the record for the biggest UK audience for a sitcom episode, attracting 24.3 million viewers.
